simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֲלִי (H2481) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֲלִי (chălîy) means a trinket (as polished) First listed occurrence: Prov 25 12.

definitions.full: H2481. chali I. חֲלִי noun masculine ornament , וַחֲלִיכָּֿ֑תֶם זָחָב נֶזֶם Prov 25:12 a (nose-or-ear-) ring of gold and (neck-or breast-) ornament of fine gold ; plural חֲלָאִים Cant 7:2, in simile of grace and beauty.
